name: andesine
description: Search, read, write, and publish Andesine workspace content
long_description: Connects Claude to an Andesine workspace with an API key: search and read entries, edit them as MDX, upload local images, save versions, and publish. The key's workspace and permissions limit what Claude can do.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A secret API key from the workspace's API settings. Its permissions limit the tools.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: The API URL of a self-hosted instance

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: List only the tools that read content
